messages:
Alex B: Quick cross-team check — traffic slice plan for the v2 cutover. Need final owners for slices, SDK header fallback, and infra smoke window. Who's taking west-eu and the SDK header shim?
Maria S: I can take west-eu slice (eng-platform). Will coordinate routing and dashboarding.
Sam L: I can own the SDK header fallback. We plan to accept both `x-rdwd-api-version` and `x-api-version` for one week. Need a compatibility shim from platform to translate older clients.
Jen K: Router/runtime needs the exact header names to wire KV-cache keys. Prefer single canonical header downstream. Can you confirm the canonical name?
Sam L: canonical = `x-rdwd-api-version`. SDKs will send `x-api-version` for older releases; I'll add a shim in the SDK client and a small mapping in the gateway.
Oliver P: For infra, we can open a 30m smoke window during the weekday cutover. Proposed: Mon 6pm PST -> 6:30pm PST. Canary in us-west-2, then eu-west-1, then global.
Alex B: Sounds good. @deploy-bot can we schedule the canary for Mon 18:00 PST? Also we need a pre-cutover checklist: healthcheck, token-propagation, metrics alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: Mon 2026-03-23 18:00 PST — us-west-2 -> eu-west-1. Ticket: #CI-9876 :rocket: 
Maria S: Checklist notes — healthcheck: `/healthz` latency < 100ms, error rate < 0.5%; telemetry: enable `v2_migration` flag dimension.
Jen K: Runtime snippet for header translation (we'll add to runtime config):
```
map $http_x_api_version $rdwd_api_version {
    default $http_x_rdwd_api_version;
    ~.+ $http_x_api_version;
}
proxy_set_header X-RDWD-API-VERSION $rdwd_api_version;
```
Sam L: Thanks — I'll update SDKs and add the fallback tests. PR coming: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/2345 (adds header mapping + tests).
Alex B: Ownership recap: west-eu -> Maria S; SDK header shim & client fallback -> Sam L; runtime header mapping -> Jen K; canary & timing -> Oliver P. Any blockers?
Maria S: Dependency: we need the gateway ACL change merged (eng-infra PR #778). Waiting on infra review.
Oliver P: I'll ping infra reviewers and escalate if not green by EOD Fri.
Sam L: I'll add a smoke test that hits the legacy header path and asserts identical responses for a small prompt set.
Alex B: Great. Action items: Sam + Jen to sync on exact test endpoints, Maria to confirm dashboard widgets, Oliver to lock canary schedule with infra. We'll run a final async sign-off thread 2h before cutover. :thumbsup:
